title: Electric guitar body
summary: freeform carve, routed pockets, scale formulas
description: An original double-cutaway solid body in red alder with a carved top, a bolt-on neck pocket, two humbucker routes, a rear control cavity and a string-through bridge placed by the scale length, finished in candy-apple red.
process: CNC routing, carving with a ball-nose cutter, roundover, paint and clear coat

difficulty.rationale: A freeform spline outline, a Gordon network of 24 B-spline curves with knot formulas from tables, and pockets and angled drills tied to the scale length, built around kernel limits F-120 to F-122.

standards: Fender-pattern bolt-on neck pocket and four-bolt neck plate
materials: Red alder, 450 kg/m³, candy-apple red over a metallic base, clear coat

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: saddle 128.31 mm, heel arc 198.943 mm, pocket 29.125/15.875 mm, routes 21.000 mm and 67.489 mm apart, wall 6.000 mm, 18 corners of 1/4 in, jack clearance 2.42 mm, all as this example's; mass 1.859 kg (+1.7 %); 17 checks pass over the range; one edge-of-tolerance pocket refusal on a plateau flat to 0.6 µm; about 164 steps.
